raw_text: Kotlin Multiplatform Vulkan 1.4 wrapper; RAII handles, exceptions, context-scoped allocation. Full API/extensions except deprecated/unsupported: render passes/framebuffers, custom allocators, raytracing. Modules: kotlinx-datetime, kotlinx-io, volk, volk-kotlin, vulkan-kotlin, sample. Targets modern desktop/mobile GPUs; minimum driver Vulkan 1.3. Support `VK_KHR_dynamic_rendering`, `VK_KHR_dynamic_rendering_local_read`, `VK_EXT_extended_dynamic_state2`, `VK_KHR_synchronization2`. Sort class functions public then private, lexicographically. `Device` factory for classes needing `VkDevice`. Native allocation: pass `NativePlacement` context parameter; caller handles allocation/freeing. Core functionality must be used when also available as extension. Every `public` class, function and property must have a KDoc. Run tests and static analysis: `./gradlew check`
